title: Stream Upgrade: Ellie.exe
overview: You have 12 viewers, $47 in the bank, and a ceiling crack shaped like a middle finger. You’re Eli, a nobody streamer drowning in dead chat and instant ramen until you discover RegenaForm, a biotech clinic that can sculpt your body like clay using your own DNA. One eyelash treatment. One voice change. One new face. The viewers start climbing. The donations start flowing.

title: Zabulon’s Archive
overview: Zabulon’s Archive isn’t a visual novel. It’s many, MANY visual novels. Some are original stories, others are fictions involving numerous characters and universes. Some contain GIFs, others contain AI renders using a wide variety of artistic styles. All are smutty. Do you want to follow the story of a stripper reuniting with her grumpy high school teacher while she performs on stage? Or an Onlyfans model getting recognized by her boyfriend’s dad? A girl who has to pretend to be a love doll during a business meeting? Are you interested in seeing Gwen Stacy trying to wreck her mom’s marriage? Hermione “comforting” a heartbroken Hagrid? Momo Ayase having a one-night stand? Those stories and many more await you in the Archive. You just need to read them (harsh, I know).

title: Master Battler
overview: Master battler is a rogue-like autobattler where you unlock images (and videos in the future) moving forward in the maps, find out how to mutate your fighters and discover them all in the dex.

title: A Mirror’s Curse
overview: A Mirror’s Curse is a transgender transformation game created in Twine using the Sugarcube format. In this story-driven adventure, you step into the shoes of Ethan Yoon, an ordinary high school senior enjoying a seemingly typical life. Everything changes when visiting the Autumn Festival with friends takes a strange turn. There, Ethan encounters Madame Serena, a mysterious seer who curses him after he secretly records their conversation. Her cryptic warning, that the mirror will shift every time he acts on something he cannot see, reveals its true meaning as Ethan begins to transform. He physically becomes more feminine with every traditionally feminine action he takes.

title: La Vitalis: Immortal Loss
overview: An alluring young student of the medical arts… A golden kingdom ravaged by an unknown disease… And the secrets of alchemy that could consume everything… Vita, an extraordinarily youthful and gifted plague doctor, struggles to find a cure for the strange infection destroying her home. Having spent her entire life in serious studies, she has no time for relationships or frivolous activities…but for a young, elegant beauty, there are monsters more malicious than viruses…

title: The Donk Date
overview: It’s an interactive fiction with a linear plot and some minor game mechanics. A girl slowly changes into a donkey creature. There are some pitfalls and it’s important to find the right dialogs. There are also some important items you have to find. The game is still in the works and unfinished content is only available for supporters.

title: MILF’s Plaza 2
overview: Milf’s Plaza 2 is an erotic attraction for those who like it hot. Everything you loved about the first part — multiplied and improved.

title: Amakano ~Second Season~ PLUS
overview: A story of a hot summer that couldn’t be told in SS, alongside stories between the protagonist and each of the heroines. An intimacy and trust that were impossible as mere lovers, and a life of loving each other side by side, every day. The special feeling and thrill that only the “PLUS” version has. This is the fandisc for Amakano ~Second Season~

title: Cuckold Desire
overview: After a painful argument, a young woman named Sarah and her husband try to rebuild their relationship. However, as the tension between them slowly fades, new fantasies begin to ignite! What if they tried something new? They both start wondering more and more what they truly want and how far they are willing to go to fulfill those desires. You’ll follow the development of their relationship, make decisions, and explore their secret fantasies. Can you save your marriage by taking a chance on something new? Will you give Sarah enough freedom? Start the game and find out how this complicated yet surprisingly relatable story of an ordinary young couple will end!

title: Summer Tales
overview: Some secrets follow you across centuries. Summer Tales is a heavy visual novel about betrayal, jealousy and blackmail. Decide whom to confront, what to reveal and which relationships are worth holding onto. Then a dinner celebration takes an impossible turn—and the people you can’t trust become the people you need. Meaningful choices. Fractured loyalties. An unexpected mystery. weekly interactible vn

title: Pinked and Owned
overview: Pinked and Owned is an adult HTML/browser narrative game about slow feminization and a life quietly rearranging itself. You play a guy with a small chastity cage, a complicated roommate, and the kind of job that keeps asking him to wear something new. Stat-driven sandbox, explore the city, build (or lose) your resolve, and watch the story branch based on choices you didn’t even realise were choices. Active solo dev, new content every 2-3 weeks.

title: Eroded Twins - The Downfall of the Empire
overview: Long ago, a war between humans and demons ravaged the continent until the Demon King was sealed away, bringing an end to the conflict. Now, three nations coexist in relative peace: the law-bound Celestia Empire, the commerce-driven Mercant Duchy, and the demon-inhabited region of Necrosia. At the heart of these territories lies the Kingdom of Edelwald, where a princess must risk everything to protect her kingdom.

title: Netorase Wife Training ~Letting Another Man Hold Her, Making Her Fall with My Fingers~
overview: You, the husband, will personally persuade your initially reluctant wife, Kasumi, to become involved with another man. Over twenty days, you send her out, await her return, and gradually reshape your once-harmonious marriage through your own actions. The game emphasizes the wife's perspective, interactive touch-based H-scenes, and the slow psychological deterioration of everyday married life.

title: Spellbound Command
overview: Build an army, bind heroes, increase bonds, and destroy the enemy. Spellbound Command combines tactical RTS with dating simulations and detailed visual novels.

title: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
overview: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

title: ERO FIGHTERS
overview: Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?! You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga. Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

title: OnlyRifts
overview: Rifts open into hundreds of worlds, and behind each one there's a girl. You manage them, and the first one through is Juno, a catgirl streamer from Neon City. On stream, chat tips her for requests and you pick which ones she does. Push too hard and the platform hands out strikes. Play it too safe and her viewers drift off. Off stream, she's all yours. She video calls you, and every call is a little card game where you read her mood and play your lines. She texts you and sends selfies. She tries on outfits for you, drags you out on dates and lets you learn exactly where she likes to be touched. She's got a card Drop too, and you get a free pull every 12 hours. The closer you get, the further her private shows go. 0.1 is free and has Juno's whole route. More girls and worlds are on the way. Every character is 18+. Both female characters are already corrupted, but in this game, time has passed, and Radia and Kanza have slowed down a lot when it comes to sex, It’s up to you to show them that you can get anything if you know where to put your hands… MetF After the wait , it’s not Chapter 4 , it’s true that it’s the same characters, but time has passed, so let’s just say it’s not quite the same vibe.

title: REBELLIOUN
overview: A living NTR village sandbox that keeps moving even when you look away. Play a humble blacksmith under an occupying gang. Fifteen women, corrupted loyalties, dark secrets, dire consequences, pregnancy. Protect your wife and daughter at all costs... and the rest, if you can.

title: Entropy - The Struggle of Fate
overview: After a failed attack on the Frainnan village, Varnel is promptly captured by the enemy chief. Understanding his role in the ceremony, he makes peace with his fate, only for the chief to spare his life and keep him as a prisoner. For a reason or another, the Frainnan tries to assimilate him in their way of life.

title: Road of a Goddess 2
overview: Explore a stylish early preview of the scenic Las Diosas canals in the first level. Fight off initial enemies along the waterways and unlock new alternative outfits. The second scene traps the girls deep inside a dangerous, late-game mine level. Collect mysterious glowing elements to illuminate the pitch-black areas of the cavern. Test powerful new combat mechanics like the devastating forward-facing Milk Blast. Use Jacquelyn's spinning Sword Blender to shred groups of enemies and cross wide gaps. Execute Montse's heavy three-hit Hammer Combo to trap targets right in their tracks. Touch Montse during the combo to dynamically power up the damage of each strike. Get an exclusive hands-on look at the evolving gameplay, visuals, and tech features.
